text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for on-call group 'eng-oncall' — HIGH - gpu-host-unreachable (gpunode-13.redwood.internal) — metric: node_heartbeat_missing for 3m 18s

pagerduty: Incident created (PD-4579). Alert link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-4579 — escalation policy: eng-oncall -> infra-escalation

alex: acked the page. I'm on it. starting timeline now.

morgan: seeing the page. ping if you need serial access or host power cycle. grabbing console creds. :tools:

alex: quick facts: host gpunode-13 lost heartbeat, kubelet NotReady, pods flapping with ImagePullBackOff? actually replication controllers showing Evicted/CrashLoop from eviction. I can't reach kubelet via kubectl (connection timed out).

alex: trying ssh -> connection timed out. ICMP also dead. probably kernel panic or network isolation. asking infra to attach serial.

morgan: attaching serial console now — id: serial-attach-789. will paste output.

morgan: (serial) last logs show: "[    5.432109] NMI watchdog: BUG: soft lockup - CPU#3 stuck for 22s" then "Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal trap" then stack trace. looks like kernel panic.

alex: ok kernel panic confirmed. good to know. customer impact: currently 6 inference workers on that node, active requests failing with 503 from frontends in region-us-west2. I see spikes in 5xxs in frontend -> routing fallback engaged.

priya: alert dashboard shows ~1200 failed inference requests in last 5m, 95th latency backoffs. tagging support to notify affected tenants.

alex: attempt: kubectl cordon gpunode-13 -> refuses (kubelet unreachable). tried kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data but it fails waiting for node to be reachable.

dario: suggestion: create temporary routing override to avoid sending new requests to that rack/host group. I can update routing policy if you give me the node selector or ASG label.

alex: node labels: rack=rn5, gpu-type=A100v4. please add exclusion for rack=rn5 region-us-west2 for 10m.

dario: done. routing rule applied. new traffic split: -10% offloaded to dedicated-fallback, autoscaler spinning up extra replicas.

morgan: we can try reboot via BMC, but if kernel panic persists might need hardware replace. i'm going to power-cycle now (IPMI).

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4579 — alex acknowledged (2639991125). On-call elapsed: 3m.

morgan: ipmi power cycle issued. console shows boot sequence. but POST shows NVMe controller errors; may be underlying storage causing panic.

alex: after reboot, kubelet came up but then evicted pods due to disk read errors. nodes kernel logs show repeated 'NVMe error: Media Error' and then OOM/killer triggered earlier.

priya: customer impact update for status page: A subset of inference requests in us-west2 are degraded; fallback and retries in place. ETA unknown. drafting post: "Investigating node failure affecting some inference requests in US-West. We're routing around affected rack and scaling capacity."

dario: infra wants us to mark host out of rotation and open a hardware ticket with vendor. Morgan, can you set host to decommission and create HW ticket with serial and NVMe logs?

morgan: creating ticket now (HW-12233) with serial logs attached. I'll also request on-site tech for NVMe replacement.

alex: next steps for app side: monitor retries, increase fallback capacity by 20% for 30m, run alert suppression for this node to avoid duplicate noise. Also run a smoke eval to ensure quality.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-4579 — escalated to infra-escalation at 2639991189.

priya: I'm taking handoff for the remaining mitigation (customer comms, postmortem owner). alex handing active oncall back in 20m if things stable. :wave:

alex: thanks. leaving details: kernel panic -> NVMe media errors -> host rebooted -> kubelet up briefly -> disk errors causing pod evictions -> hardware ticket opened. I'll add commands and logs to the incident doc. handing to priya at 2639991255.

priya: ack. I'll own follow-ups: coordinate vendor RMA, postmortem, and ensure routing rule is reverted after capacity is stable. tagging @support to prepare affected-customer list for outreach. :lock:

incident-bot: PD-4579 acknowledged by alex at 2639991125, assigned to priya for follow-up at 2639991255.

pagerduty: PD-4579 status: acknowledged -> in progress.

(--- thread end ---)
